target_statement: For all natural L>=1,r>=1, let J=(L/2-1)/r with the unchanged selected blocks. Construct a complete duplicate-free list of exactly all n with Agent101.decimalWidth n L, original Lychrel196.Palindrome n, and forall j<J, not P196.Agent9.Ensemble.NumericMarker n L (1+j*r) r. Its length is Q=9*10^((L+1)/2-1-r*J)*(10^r-1)^J.

Derive the complete all-width initial-palindrome count P=9*10^((L+1)/2-1), reusing the same intersection enumeration at r=L and the proved J=0 case. Preserve the full canonical interval, including the explicit L=1 case.

With U=9*10^(L-1-2*r*J)*(10^(2*r)-1)^J from the already checked complete marker complement, prove that its initially nonpalindromic sublist has exact length U-Q and that the union of initially palindromic and unmarked canonical seeds has length U+P-Q.

Specialize r=FiniteHorizonBlocks.blockLength R. For the complete canonical-width filtered actual orbit event, prove the count of hits at some t with 0<=t<=R+1 is at most U+P-Q; for initially nonpalindromic seeds prove the count of hits at some 1<=t<=R+1 is at most U-Q. Reuse the original positive-hit subset/safety result unchanged.

Prove the full initially-nonpalindromic conditioning ensemble has exact count 9*10^(L-1)-P and is positive for every L>=2. These finite counts provide the integer counterparts of the written probability refinements; do not assume independence of initial palindromicity and marker events.
boundaries: L=1 has all nine seeds initially palindromic and zero nonpalindromic conditioning denominator
Odd/even widths, center length L%2<=1, nonzero leading digit and allowed trailing zero
Whole diagonal r-block factor 10^r-1; pair-list order is preserved under reversal while each pair is swapped
Prove the natural free exponent has its intended nonnegative meaning and Q<=U,P before subtraction identities
Exact time-zero inclusive event versus positive-time event; no altered reverse-add semantics
